title: Fee Carry Limit on Rural Home Loans Replacement Remittances for Farm Real Estate Borrowers
content:
Schedule of the limit on the fees a Rural Home Loans replacement remittance carries, for members who also borrow on Farm Real Estate Loans.

## Rule

The fees a replacement carries are limited for a member who also holds an active farm real estate loan with the association: when that farm loan shows at least two principal installments paid and no farm loan late charge in the last 24 months, an installment whose remittance was returned not counting as paid, at most 35.00 USD of fees is carried; when it is active and shows a farm loan late charge in the last 24 months, at most 60.00 USD is carried; otherwise the fees carry in full; fees beyond the limit stay unpaid on the loan. The replacement includes the lower of the fees carried and the limit.

## Records read on the Farm Real Estate Loans side

- Whether the member's farm real estate loan is in active status.
- Principal installments paid on the farm loan in the last 24 months: principal payments booked, less principal payment returns booked, from the day after the same calendar day 24 months before today through today.
- Late-charge fees assessed on the farm loan in those 24 months.

## Schedule

| Active farm real estate loan | Farm installments paid, net of returns | Farm late charge in 24 months | Most fees carried |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | none | 35.00 |
| yes | any number | one or more | 60.00 |
| yes | 0 or 1 | none | no limit |
| none active | — | — | no limit |

## Worked case (hypothetical inputs)

Fees carried of 83.00 for a member whose active farm loan shows four installments paid and no late charge: 35.00 is carried and 48.00 stays unpaid on the home loan. With a farm late charge in the 24 months, 60.00 is carried and 23.00 stays unpaid. With fees carried of 20.00, either limit leaves the 20.00 in full.
